Taco Tuesday Social Ride (Allen)

Allen, TX · Social

Taco Tuesday Social Ride (Allen) is a social group ride in Allen, TX. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:45 pm from Velvet Taco.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:45 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: social pace, on paved trails.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

About the Taco Tuesday Social Ride (Allen) group ride

A weekly social ride on paved trails out of Velvet Taco in Allen. About 12 miles at a social pace, with food and drinks after. Run by a Meetup group that mixes trail rides and pub rides.
